subject: PO Issuance Validation — MeridianTech onboarding, spend silo & line-item cleanup
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@meridiantech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@meridiantech.com
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: MeridianTech onboarding — PO request and spend caps

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward and need a provisional PO and spend cap so our finance team can complete the vendor setup. Can you confirm the PO numbering format you use and whether we can split spend across two cost centers?

I've attached the completed onboarding form and a sample invoice so you can map line items against your ledger. We have an initial commitment of $120k for Q3 with two line items: Platform (monthly) and Professional Services (one-off).

Attachments: [Meridian_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf)], [Meridian_Invoice_Sample.xlsx (xlsx)]

Primary ask: provisional PO number + temporary spend cap assigned to cost centers MT-OPS and MT-ENG so procurement can finish the setup.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement
MeridianTech

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@meridiantech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MeridianTech onboarding — PO request and spend caps

Elena —

Thanks, received the form and sample invoice. Looping in Monica (Procurement ops) and Priyom (Billing) to assign a provisional PO and reconcile ledger mapping.

Quick notes / what we'll do next: 
- Monica will validate the onboarding form against our vendor master and confirm tax/legal fields.
- Priyom will propose a provisional PO number and a split spend allocation between MT-OPS and MT-ENG.
- We'll return a single provisional PO that can be split on our side into two ledger lines (we'll include the PO stub and the internal split coding for your invoice).

If there's any special billing reference Meridian requires on invoices (vendor_ref or project codes), add that to the onboarding form and flag it in replies. We'll aim to return the provisional PO by EOD.

Jordan
Director, Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@meridiantech.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MeridianTech onboarding — PO request and spend caps

Elena / team —

Checked the onboarding form: legal name and TIN are correct, bank details redacted (we require vendor portal verification). A couple of line-item clarifications needed before we issue a provisional PO: 

1) Invoice line description mismatch — the sample invoice lumps "Platform + PS" in one line for $60k. For our ledger we need separate lines for "Platform Subscription (monthly)" and "Professional Services (SOW)" with SKU codes if possible.
2) Spend allocation — you requested split across MT-OPS / MT-ENG. We'll issue one provisional PO (RT-77821) with two funded lines: 
   - Line 1: Platform (MT-OPS) — provisional cap $80,000 (covers forecasted usage through Sep)
   - Line 2: Professional Services (MT-ENG) — provisional cap $40,000 (one-off SOW)
3) Temporary spend hold — we'll apply a provisional spend hold that requires an invoice-level comment referencing the PO + cost center.

I'll attach the provisional PO stub once Priyom confirms the reference coding. Can you resend the invoice with the two-line breakdown and, if available, the SOW reference? That will speed approval.

Attachments: [PO_provisional_#RT-77821-draft.pdf (pdf) — DRAFT, pending final coding]

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@meridiantech.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MeridianTech onboarding — PO request and spend caps

Hi all —

Finalized the provisional PO reference and internal routing: 
- Provisional PO: RT-77821 (issued, attached final stub)
- Ledger split: RT-77821-L1 -> MT-OPS (cost center 4302) — cap $80,000; RT-77821-L2 -> MT-ENG (cost center 4410) — cap $40,000
- Invoices must include: PO RT-77821 + cost center code (4302 or 4410) in the invoice header for auto-matching.
- If Meridian sends a combined invoice we will require a credit memo or a corrected invoice that itemizes both lines. We can temporarily accept combined invoices if they include a detailed line breakout attached.

I've uploaded the final PO stub to the shared drive and set the vendor portal provisional status to "pending verification" until bank details are validated. Links / artifacts below.

Attachments: [PO_provisional_#RT-77821.pdf (pdf)]
Links: https://redwooddrive.example/Shared/Onboarding/MT/PO_RT-77821
HubSpot: MT-2093

Jordan — can you confirm for Elena that the split coding is acceptable on Meridian's side? Elena — once we receive the revised invoice, we will remove the provisional spend hold and complete vendor activation.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
